notes: v2.129 (2026-11-23, afternoon run): 128th tower 'Poinsettia' (red bracts over a yellow centre, green leaves, a stem and a blue pot — a potted Christmas plant silhouette to demolish, 30 blocks, 4 clusters sizes 12/10/5/3, all 4 colours, no singletons, 0 canonical duplicates) + 125th co-play prompt (meet a real poinsettia — touch one red leaf gently saying 'soft… soft!', count the little yellow flowers in the middle, say 'red… red!' for the colour; the plant stays in its pot, a grown-up holds it steady, wash hands after — the milky sap can itch sensitive skin; leaves stay out of mouths).
